title: HOW IT
WORKS
scenes.voice: Here is exactly how the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge works. It takes just a few hours a day.

scenes.title: Your Daily Routine
scenes.voice: Watch the eight A. M. reel, solve the free practice set, take the test at seven P. M., and if you make the top three, you will be featured in the next reel.

scenes.title: The Rules
scenes.voice: Monday to Saturday, with Sundays off. Topic tests are open from seven to nine P. M., full mocks from seven to eleven. Enrol once in the course for just one rupee.

scenes.title: Starts
scenes.voice: Comment GATE ninety to get the course link and our Telegram. Day one is Monday, nineteenth October.
